issues.problem: This is a unit error. Tesla's fiscal 2021 net income attributable to common stockholders was about $5.5 billion ($5,519M), not $5.5 million. The 127.5% growth figure is only consistent with $5.5 billion.

data.summary: Most figures match Tesla's reported results. Revenue was $81.5B vs $53.8B (+51.4%). Gross profit was $20.9B vs $13.6B, a 25.6% gross margin. Operating income was $13.7B vs $6.5B, a 16.8% operating margin. Net income was $12.6B, up 127.5%. Diluted EPS was $3.62 vs $1.63 (split-adjusted), and R&D was $3.1B vs $2.6B. The one error is that fiscal 2021 net income is given as $5.5 million instead of $5.5 billion.
